rule.question: does the partner's card rule (shipped opening-range break, index stop, sell at the index target, else square off) make money per lot on NIFTY in 2024, 2025 and Jan - Oct 2026?
rule.card_passes: CARD|shipped passes if, per lot after the replay's costs: net > 0 in each of 2024, 2025 and 2026; net > 0 over the three years after an extra Rs 200 per trade; net > 0 over the three years without its best day; not negative in more than 1 of the 6 half-years; at least 40 trades a year; and net above the median of the 20 random-entry books (same stop, target and exits) in every year
rule.exits_question: informational, decided in advance: the card's exits beat the book's own exits on the same entries if CARD|shipped nets more than REF|shipped_book_exits in every year
rule.on_pass: the card is a tested lead for the partner: build the card-led watch messages (messages only, a switch, never a block) and keep scoring the cards forward; profit is still not promised
rule.on_fail: the partner is not coached to lean on the card; the finding is reported as it is
rule.status: 2024, 2025 and Jan - Oct 2026 are seen for F&O rules, but this rule is the shipped card, unchanged and not chosen on these years; Jan - May 2022 stays reserved for the N012 exam and is not read; no setting is tuned on this result
